verdict.rationale: WooCommerce natively generates REST API keys bound to a specific WordPress user. Each key is limited to that user's roles and capabilities and to a chosen Read, Write, or Read/Write access level, so an agent can get a read-only key tied to a limited-role user. The scoping is coarse, though, and nothing ties it to agent or MCP use. Missing for 10: fine-grained per-resource or per-endpoint scopes, key expiry/rotation documentation, agent/MCP-specific credential scoping, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Use of the REST API with the generated keys will conform to that user's WordPress roles and capabilities.
Choose the level of access for this REST API key, which can be Read access, Write access or Read/Write access.
